sentences.text:
Petitioner :- Sheela Kumari
Respondent :- Sanjay Sonkar And 4 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Jayant Rai Hon'ble Ms. Nand Prabha Shukla,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned A.G.A for the State and perused the record.

This petition under Article 227 of the Constitution of India has been filed seeking direction to the court concerned to decide the Case No. 336 of 2023 (Sheela Kumari Vs. Sanjay Sonkar & Ors.) under Sections 498A, 452, 323, 504, 506 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Chunar, District Mirzapur pending in the Court of learned Civil Judge (Junior Division) F.T.C. (C.A.W.), District Mirzapur within a stipulated time or in a time frame.

entities.text: Case No. 336 of 2023 (Sheela Kumari Vs. Sanjay Sonkar & Ors.)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Civil Judge (Junior Division) F.T.C. (C.A.W.), District Mirzapur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Considering the fact that the trial has remained pending since long time.

Without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this petition is finally disposed of with a direction to the court concerned to decide the aforesaid case, as expeditiously as possible, without granting any unnecessary or long adjournments to either of the parties, from the date of production of a certified copy of this order, if there is no other legal impediment.
Order Date :- 7.5.2025
